channel.title: Jason Bateman Joins The Best People With Nicolle Wallace
channel.desc: Award-winning actor and director Jason Bateman joins Nicolle Wallace for a special TV edition of her new podcast, The Best People With Nicolle Wallace; they dive into the wild twists and turns of the Trump era, including why Jason compares the president to an "arsonist"; Jason also reflects on his hilarious dynamic with Smartless co-hosts Will Arnett and Sean Hayes, and dishes on some political gossip he heard at a Hollywood party.
